description: Complete L-1011-100 TriStar parked in the open beside the pyramid-shaped museum, part of Sheikh Hamad bin Hamdan Al Nahyan's collection. c/n 193N-1093, first flight 14 Oct 1974; ex G-BBAF with British Airways and Caledonian, then 3C-QRL and A8-AAB, last operated from Ras Al Khaimah as TT-DWE for AMW Tchad / International Air Services flying to Chad and Nigeria (JetPhotos captions; airteamimages 6 May 2012). Photographed at the museum repeatedly 2010-2019 and on 2 Oct 2025 (JetPhotos, described as deteriorating in the desert heat). Visitors cannot board (Khaleej Times 1 Aug 2024, which mis-describes it as a three-engined Douglas). Coordinates are the museum building; the aircraft stands immediately beside it.
